paragraphs: Parking BOXX designs and builds parking control systems and parking equipment for surface lots, parking garages, hospitals, hotels, universities, airports, and municipal facilities across North America. A complete parking control system includes barrier gates, ticket machines or pay stations, LPR cameras, access control readers, and management software. The CloudEASE software platform provides real-time dashboards, remote access control, online reservations, pay-by-plate, and automated reporting.

Parking BOXX serves every US state and Canadian province, with systems in operation from Los Angeles to Newfoundland and from Alaska to Key West. The company states over 85 years of combined parking industry experience, with roots dating to 1939. Buyers purchase directly from the company that designed and built the equipment rather than from a reseller.

For operators removing booth staff, Parking BOXX describes an unattended parking system of barrier gates, pay stations, LPR cameras, and CloudEASE software that manages the operation remotely. Pages on parking revenue describe LPR cameras that eliminate tailgating, barrier gates that close cleanly after every vehicle, and pay stations that accept every payment method.

quote.text: Parking BOXX manufactures every major category of parking equipment in-house.
